programme_name: Islamic medium term notes programme of up to RM10.0 billion based on Wakalah Bi Al-Istithmar
overall_summary: TNB's RM10 billion 50-year Islamic MTN programme using Wakalah structure, targeting sustainability and conventional sukuk issuances. AAA-rated programme by RAM with flexibility for green/social sukuk under ASEAN standards. Major infrastructure financing platform for Malaysia's national electricity utility.

deal_snapshot.islamic_concept: Wakalah Bi Al-Istithmar and Murabahah (via Tawarruq arrangement)
deal_snapshot.mode_of_offer: Private/direct placement, Bought deal, Book building

key_parties.lead_arranger: CIMB Investment Bank Berhad and Maybank Investment Bank Berhad
key_parties.shariah_adviser: CIMB Islamic Bank Berhad and Maybank Islamic Berhad
key_parties.principal_advisers: CIMB Investment Bank Berhad and Maybank Investment Bank Berhad
key_parties.lead_arrangers: CIMB Investment Bank Berhad and Maybank Investment Bank Berhad
key_parties.lead_managers: CIMB Investment Bank Berhad and Maybank Investment Bank Berhad
key_parties.shariah_advisers: CIMB Islamic Bank Berhad and Maybank Islamic Berhad
key_parties.independent_external_reviewer: Sustainalytics UK Limited and/or other Independent External Reviewer to be appointed

issuer_profile.principal_activities: Generation, transmission, distribution and sales of electricity
issuer_profile.substantial_shareholders: Employees Provided Fund Board, Khazanah Nasional Berhad, Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperdabankan), Amanah Saham Bumiputera

profit_structure.ibra_provision: Ibra' granted by Sukukholders on Deferred Sale Price upon dissolution, early redemption, or for Sustainability-Linked Sukuk on periodic distribution dates and scheduled dissolution dates

use_of_proceeds.description: Investment in TNB's Shariah-compliant general business (at least 33% of proceeds) and Commodity Murabahah Investment for the remaining balance

eligible_projects.green_projects: Green Projects as per ASEAN Green Bond Standards and other applicable sustainability frameworks
eligible_projects.social_projects: Social Projects as per ASEAN Social Bond Standards and other applicable sustainability frameworks
eligible_projects.certification_requirements: Compliance with TNB Transition Finance Framework and applicable Sustainability Guidelines/Frameworks or Sustainability-Linked Guidelines/Frameworks

covenants_summary.positive_covenants: Deliver information to Sukuk Trustee, exercise reasonable diligence in business, maintain authorisations and licenses, maintain paying agent in Malaysia, prepare financial statements in accordance with approved accounting standards, maintain proper accounting records, comply with applicable laws
covenants_summary.negative_covenants: No constitution amendments inconsistent with Transaction Documents, no reduction of paid-up share capital with Material Adverse Effect, no material business changes with Material Adverse Effect, no use of proceeds for non-Shariah purposes, no creation of security interests except permitted securities, restrictions on asset disposals, no dividend payments if sukuk amounts remain unpaid
covenants_summary.information_covenants: Notify Sukuk Trustee of changes in financial condition or litigation with Material Adverse Effect, notify of any Dissolution Events and take remedial steps, comply with additional information covenants for Sustainability sukuk

dissolution_events_summary: Non-payment of nominal value or periodic distributions (5 business day grace period)
Breach of Transaction Document obligations with Material Adverse Effect (30 day cure period)
Material misrepresentation in Transaction Documents (30 day cure period)
Cross-default on other financial indebtedness with Material Adverse Effect (90 day cure period)
Appointment of receivers or enforcement of security over substantial assets
Creditor arrangements or compositions affecting material indebtedness
Revocation of material licenses or authorisations
Seizure or nationalisation of substantial assets
Disposal or adverse changes to Government's Special Share
Material adverse events not remedied within 60 days
Material change in business nature or scope
selling_restrictions: Schedule 5, Part I, 1(b) of the CMSA (consideration not less than RM250,000)
Schedule 6 of the CMSA — Sophisticated investors
Schedule 7 of the CMSA — Sophisticated investors
risk_highlights: 50-year tenor creates significant duration and interest rate risk
Exposure to regulatory changes in Malaysia's electricity sector
Dependence on TNB's operational performance in Shariah-compliant business
Commodity price volatility affecting Murabahah investments
Sustainability-linked sukuk subject to ESG performance adjustments
Government ownership structure changes could trigger dissolution events

glossary.definition: Islamic investment agency contract where the Sukuk Trustee appoints TNB as agent to invest sukuk proceeds in Shariah-compliant investments on behalf of investors
Islamic sale contract involving purchase and sale of commodities at cost-plus-profit, with the buyer selling the commodities to obtain liquidity
Shariah concept of debt forgiveness or waiver, where sukukholders release their rights to certain amounts under specific circumstances
Compensation payable under Islamic law for actual losses incurred due to breach of fiduciary duty or delayed payments
Event of default under Islamic finance structure that triggers acceleration and enforcement of sukuk obligations
